responsibility: Coordinates ABI lowering for rustc_codegen_cranelift by translating Rust function ABIs and calling conventions into Cranelift signatures, importing callable references, adjusting special library-call and variadic-call conventions, initializing local mappings for parameters and returns via submodules, and dispatching drop calls according to the callee ABI.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is the call-boundary layer: it turns Rust `FnAbi` and calling conventions into Cranelift signatures and call sites, including imported functions, libcall/variadic-call ABI adjustments, and drop-call dispatch. It is about executable ABI lowering rather than debuginfo metadata, driver orchestration, intrinsic dispatch, or optimization submodule grouping.
